index_note: Locked strategy uses Python close[31] (Session32 execution) through close[61] (Session62). Direction labels still use Session31 to Session61. Literal one-based Session31-to61 is separately reported and has a different always-sell return because next-close slippage is included.

cost_conventions.A: 0.30% multiplicative cost at each actual sell; unexited holdings marked to market at terminal close.
cost_conventions.B: Same, with terminal 0.30% liquidation cost also charged to every unexited holding.

execution_assumptions: Next observed close execution; no intraday fills or guaranteed liquidity.
No cash interest, dividends, tax or borrow cost. Re-entry companion charges 0.30% on each buy/sell transition.
First-exit policy remains in cash; all-successive-calls is a separate optional strategy.
limitations: Retrospective corrected price series and archived summaries, not contemporaneously logged daily predictions.
Verified filing publication times gate every step; unavailable filings do not become neutral evidence.
Anchor calendar warnings are retained, not promoted to unverified hard exits.
No rule thresholds or model weights were selected using these outcomes.
Each IPO is evaluated at equal initial notional; this is not an overlapping, capital-constrained portfolio backtest.
